review_rule: Prefer an existing DS-style battle sprite when a suitable one already exists; otherwise polish/rework the best matching source without bulk-integrating the archive.

entries.reason: No existing archive candidate meets the Platinum-native quality bar while preserving a convincing Mega Spiritomb identity. Do not ship the current converted Mega sprite.
Best and only candidate already reads as a coherent DS battle sprite pair. Preserve the artwork and limit work to framing/palette/shiny cleanup.
Neither candidate has a convincing matched front/back pair. The Banished source is visually mismatched; the ER source front is stronger but its back does not represent the same finished design.
Mega Y is the most stylistically coherent front/back pair in the archive and best matches DS-era sprite construction. Use it as the working base rather than the prior community candidate.
Both candidates have severe front/back design and palette mismatch. No archive pair meets the Platinum-native quality bar.

next_action: Preserve Staraptor and Golisopod Mega Y as source bases. Do not further recolor Spiritomb, Roserade, or Lucario Z; these require true matched front/back pixel-art rework before integration.
